# CBDB-Desktop: Networks and Association Pairs revisions, 2026-10-10

Found while testing forms for the user's guide, not from an automated-testing report, so these entries have no CBDB-D numbers yet. Assign numbers as needed. All changes were compiled and tested.

## Summary

| Ref | Issue | Fix | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| NET-5 | The Networks form's person selection (ZZ_SIP_NETWORK) survived leaving and returning to the form | handleMainPage now clears ZZ_SIP_NETWORK before serving the page | Compiled, tested |
| ASP-1 | The Association Pairs form's imported list (ZZ_SIP_ASSOC_PAIR) survived leaving and returning to the form, and program restarts | handleMainPage now clears ZZ_SIP_ASSOC_PAIR before serving the page | Compiled, tested |
| ASP-2 | ZZ_SIP_ASSOC_PAIR lacked the UNIQUE (c_person_id) constraint that the import code's comments say it has | Constraint added to ensureAppTables and to the initial table definition | Compiled, tested |
| NET-6 | Labels of disabled checkboxes on the Networks form looked the same as enabled ones | CSS rule greys the label of any disabled checkbox on the Networks page | Tested |

## NET-5: Networks person selection not cleared on returning to the form

**Symptom.** After selecting or importing people on the Networks form, leaving the form and coming back showed the old person count, with All People and Run Query enabled, but with the name and ID boxes empty. Running a query used the previous selection.

**Cause.** ZZ_SIP_NETWORK (the selected input people) was cleared only at program startup, in SetupNetworksRoutes, and when a new selection replaced it. handleMainPage only served the page. On load, the page calls /api/networks/person-count, found the leftover rows and treated them as a current selection.

This is the same defect fixed on the Kinship form on 2026-09-22, where ZZ_SIP_KINSHIP had the same behaviour.

**Fix.** In networks_form_backend.go:

func (h \*NetworkHandler) handleMainPage(w http.ResponseWriter, r \*http.Request) {

if _, err := h.db.Exec(`DELETE FROM ZZ_SIP_NETWORK`); err != nil {

log.Printf("handleMainPage: could not clear ZZ_SIP_NETWORK: %v", err)

}

http.ServeFile(w, r, filepath.Join(h.templateDir, "index.html"))

}

The delete runs before the page is served, so the page's person-count request always finds 0. Run Query stays disabled until people are selected, imported or recalled. Stored IDs (ZZ_STORE_PERSON_ID) are unaffected, so Recall IDs still works. The startup delete in SetupNetworksRoutes is now redundant but was left in place.

**Dependency.** The fix relies on the noStore middleware in main.go (added 2026-09-22), which stops the browser from loading the page from its cache without contacting the server. Without it, handleMainPage would not run on a return visit.

## ASP-1: Association Pairs imported list not cleared on returning to the form

**Symptom.** Found by code review after NET-5. An imported list in ZZ_SIP_ASSOC_PAIR survived returning to the form. Unlike Networks and Kinship, this form did not clear the table at startup either, so a list also survived program restarts.

**Cause.** ZZ_SIP_ASSOC_PAIR was cleared only by handleImportList (before inserting a new list) and handleClearList. A query sent with useList: true without a fresh import would silently use the old list in handleQuery, assocLink1st and assocLink2nd.

**Fix.** The same change as NET-5, in assocpairs_form_backend.go:

func (h \*AssocPairsHandler) handleMainPage(w http.ResponseWriter, r \*http.Request) {

if _, err := h.db.Exec(`DELETE FROM ZZ_SIP_ASSOC_PAIR`); err != nil {

log.Printf("handleMainPage: could not clear ZZ_SIP_ASSOC_PAIR: %v", err)

}

http.ServeFile(w, r, filepath.Join(h.templateDir, "index.html"))

}

## ASP-2: Missing UNIQUE constraint on ZZ_SIP_ASSOC_PAIR

**Issue.** The comment in handleImportList (CBDB-D-015 follow-up) states that ZZ_SIP_ASSOC_PAIR has UNIQUE (c_person_id), and the insert uses INSERT OR IGNORE on that basis. Neither the CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS in ensureAppTables nor the initial table definition declared the constraint, so OR IGNORE had nothing to act on. No duplicates resulted, because handleImportList already removes repeated IDs in Go before inserting.

**Fix.** UNIQUE (c_person_id) was added to both definitions, matching ZZ_SIP_NETWORK.

**Note.** CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS does not change a table that already exists. A database created before this change keeps the old definition until the table is dropped and recreated. Because of the duplicate removal in Go, this has no visible effect.

## NET-6: Disabled checkbox labels not greyed out

**Change.** The **GIS export as KML** checkbox (chk-kml) and the **Include ID in Output** checkbox (chk-include-id) were moved below the buttons they modify (Save to GIS and Save to Pajek) and added to setExportButtonsEnabled, so they are enabled only when there are results. While disabled, their labels looked the same as enabled ones.

**Fix.** A rule was added to section 25 (Networks) of cbdb_styles.css:

body.networks-page input[type="checkbox"]:disabled + label {

color:  #aaa;

cursor: default;

}

The rule applies to any checkbox on the Networks page whose &lt;label&gt; directly follows it. Besides the two export checkboxes, this greys out Include Sub-Units, Limit Search by Place and Use XY (disabled until a place is selected) and Use Kinship Parameters (disabled until Kinship Relations is ticked). This was judged the right behaviour. Labels return to black automatically when the checkbox is enabled; no JavaScript change was needed.

## Behaviour to note

- **Two tabs.** Opening a second Networks or Association Pairs tab now empties the first tab's selection. This falls under the multi-tab behaviour already accepted for Kinship.
- **Locking.** The Networks delete does not take networksMu, matching the Kinship fix. Taking the lock would make the page wait for any running query to finish before loading.
